title.en: US Government Orders Export Ban on Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI Models
title.zhHans: 美国政府首次以出口管制封禁 AI 模型：Anthropic Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 被要求全球下线

searchSummary.en: US government banned Anthropic’s Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models globally in 2026 — the first export control action against AI models. How safety concerns triggered unprecedented regulation.
searchSummary.zhHans: 美国政府 2026 年首次以出口管制要求 Anthropic 的 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 全球下线——针对 AI 模型的首次出口管制行动。安全担忧如何触发了前所未有的监管手段。

summary.en: On June 12, 2026, the US Commerce Department issued an export control directive ordering Anthropic to suspend all access to its most advanced AI models, Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5, by any foreign national worldwide. Anthropic, citing inability to differentiate between US and foreign users, disabled the models for all users. The action — just three days after Fable 5's public launch — marks the first time the US government has used export control authorities to ban an AI model, classifying it as a national security concern. The Five Eyes cybersecurity alliance subsequently issued a joint statement warning that AI models capable of devastating cyberattacks are months away.
summary.zhHans: 2026年6月12日，美国商务部发布出口管制指令，要求 Anthropic 暂停其最先进 AI 模型 Claude Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 对任何外国国民的访问。Anthropic 表示无法区分美国用户和外国用户，因此将这两个模型对所有用户禁用。此举——距 Fable 5 公开发布仅三天——标志着美国政府首次动用出口管制权力封禁一个 AI 模型，将其定性为国家安全问题。五眼联盟随后发表联合声明，警告能够发动毁灭性网络攻击的 AI 模型距离现实仅剩数月。

narrative.en: Anthropic revealed its Mythos-class models in April 2026 with a 'Preview' release restricted to partner institutions, citing exceptional cybersecurity capabilities. On June 9, 2026, the company publicly launched Claude Fable 5 (a safety-aligned version) and Mythos 5 (the full capability model) via Project Glasswing. Three days later, on June 12, the US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security issued a legally binding directive ordering Anthropic to suspend access by any foreign national. The order cited national security authorities and treated the models as a 'munition' under export control law. Anthropic complied at 5:21 p.m. ET, disabling both models globally. The incident triggered a Five Eyes joint statement and sparked intense debate about AI export controls, open-source alternatives, and the balance between innovation and security.
narrative.zhHans: Anthropic 于2026年4月以'预览版'形式透露了其 Mythos 级模型，仅限合作机构访问，原因是对其异常强大的网络安全能力有所顾虑。2026年6月9日，该公司通过 Project Glasswing 公开推出了 Claude Fable 5（安全对齐版本）和 Mythos 5（完整能力版本）。三天后的6月12日，美国商务部工业与安全局发布具有法律约束力的指令，要求 Anthropic 暂停任何外国国民的访问权限。该指令引用国家安全权力，将这两个模型视为出口管制法下的'军需品'。Anthropic 于美国东部时间下午5:21执行了指令，全球范围内禁用了这两个模型。此事引发五眼联盟联合声明，并就 AI 出口管制、开源替代方案以及创新与安全的平衡展开了激烈辩论。

text.en: US Commerce Department issued a legally binding export control directive to Anthropic on June 12, 2026, ordering suspension of Fable 5 and Mythos 5 access by foreign nationals.
text.zhHans: 美国商务部于2026年6月12日向 Anthropic 发布具有法律约束力的出口管制指令，要求暂停外国国民对 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的访问。

text.en: Anthropic disabled both models for all users at 5:21 p.m. ET on June 12, citing inability to differentiate US vs foreign users.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 于美国东部时间6月12日下午5:21对所有用户禁用了这两个模型，理由是无法区分美国用户和外国用户。

text.en: Critics argued the ban was overbroad and counterproductive: by restricting access to US companies' models, it accelerated the shift toward open-source alternatives (like GLM-5.2) that have no restrictions at all.
text.zhHans: 批评者认为禁令范围过宽且适得其反：限制美国公司模型的可及性，反而加速了向完全无限制的开源替代方案（如 GLM-5.2）的转变。

text.en: Security researchers noted that treating advanced AI models as 'munitions' under export control law is a historic turning point, comparable to the regulation of cryptography in the 1990s.
text.zhHans: 安全研究人员指出，将先进 AI 模型视为出口管制法下的'军需品'是一个历史性转折点，堪比1990年代对密码学的监管。

text.en: First-ever US export ban on a general-purpose AI model, establishing a precedent for treating frontier AI as a national security asset akin to munitions.
text.zhHans: 美国首次对通用 AI 模型实施出口禁令，为将前沿 AI 视为类似军需品的国家安全资产开创了先例。

description.en: First-ever US export ban on a general-purpose AI model, establishing a precedent for treating frontier AI as a national security asset akin to munitions.
description.zhHans: 美国首次对通用 AI 模型实施出口禁令，为将前沿 AI 视为类似军需品的国家安全资产开创了先例。

description.en: The ban reshaped the global AI landscape: US export controls pushed Chinese companies to accelerate open-source development (GLM-5.2 released days later under MIT license as direct response).
description.zhHans: 禁令重塑了全球 AI 格局：美国的出口管制促使中国公司加速开源开发（GLM-5.2 数天后以 MIT 许可发布，作为直接回应）。

description.en: Five Eyes joint statement warned that AI models capable of devastating cyberattacks on governments and businesses are months away, elevating AI risk discourse to national security level.
description.zhHans: 五眼联盟联合声明警告，能够对政府和企业发动毁灭性网络攻击的 AI 模型距离现实仅剩数月，将 AI 风险讨论提升到国家安全层面。
